抢劫闯王军饷。.en: Seized the relief gold at Stonebridge Hall.
抢劫闯王军饷。.zh-CN: 在石桥会馆强夺救济黄金。

text.en: The ledger lists two chests. Where's the other one?
text.zh-CN: 账簿上记着两箱。另一箱在哪儿？

text.en: It changed hands at the ferry.
text.zh-CN: 在渡口时，到了别人手里。

text.en: Gold is remarkably sociable when nobody's watching.
text.zh-CN: 没人盯着的时候，黄金还真是很会交朋友。

text.en: So, apparently, are travelers.
text.zh-CN: 看来，旅人也一样。

text.en: Mother. We found you.
text.zh-CN: 母亲。找到你了。

text.en: And you've found the parcel, I hope.
text.zh-CN: 希望，你们也找到了包裹。

text.en: You brought someone with you?
text.zh-CN: 你还带了别人来？

text.en: A traveler from the ferry. We came to settle the question of the gold.
text.zh-CN: 渡口认识的旅人。我们来把黄金的事说清楚。

text.en: Then let's see the parcel.
text.zh-CN: 那就让我们看看包裹。

text.en: About that. It seems to have gone missing.
text.zh-CN: 说起这个，它好像丢了。

text.en: (Sinuhe points at your belongings.) Then why do you have Isis's hairpin?
text.zh-CN: （辛努赫指向你的随身物品。）那你为什么带着伊西斯的发簪？

text.en: (You should have kept track of more than the coins.)
text.zh-CN: （看来，刚才不该只顾着数金币。）

text.en: I put that in the parcel. You opened it and kept the gold?
text.zh-CN: 那是我放在包裹里的。你打开了它，还私吞了黄金？

text.en: I trusted you. That's over.
text.zh-CN: 我信任过你。到此为止了。

text.en: I can explain.
text.zh-CN: 我可以解释。

text.en: You can explain yourself after the wardens disarm you.
text.zh-CN: 等守卫缴了你的武器，你再解释吧。

text.en: Enough, Amun. Horus is still here.
text.zh-CN: 够了，阿蒙。荷鲁斯还在这里。

text.en: Horus? What happened here?
text.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯？这里发生了什么？

text.en: Hathor. What brings you to this mess?
text.zh-CN: 哈索尔。你怎么也卷进这场乱子了？

text.en: The relief gold was stolen. Anubis and I traced it to these chests.
text.zh-CN: 救济黄金被劫了。阿努比斯和我一路追查，找到了这两箱。

text.en: Anubis is here too?
text.zh-CN: 阿努比斯也在？

text.en: Yes. The villages need those supplies. We can't leave the gold in the hands of thieves.
text.zh-CN: 是的。村民需要那些补给，我们不能把黄金留在窃贼手里。

text.en: Then we need to stop pretending this is a private argument.
text.zh-CN: 那就别再把这当成几个人之间的争执了。

text.en: Then I'm not leaving without the rest.
text.zh-CN: 那我就更不能，把剩下的留在这里了。

text.en: I'd stay for the reunion, but I'm rather attached to leaving.
text.zh-CN: 我倒想留下看你们叙旧，可惜我更喜欢早点离开。

text.en: Horus? Hathor? Stay behind me.
text.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯？哈索尔？站到我身后。

text.en: Anubis, watch out. This traveler doesn't stop at taking gold.
text.zh-CN: 阿努比斯，当心。这旅人可不只想拿走黄金。

text.en: Then this is where it stops.
text.zh-CN: 那就到这里为止。

text.en: You can chase me, or you can help the people behind you.
text.zh-CN: 你可以追我，也可以先帮帮你身后的人。

text.en: Threatening the wounded won't save you.
text.zh-CN: 拿伤者作威胁，也救不了你。

text.en: You're not facing this alone.
text.zh-CN: 你不用独自面对这件事。

text.en: (Anubis gathers the wounded.) This isn't over. Horus, with me.
text.zh-CN: （阿努比斯扶起伤者。）这件事还没完。荷鲁斯，跟我走。

text.en: Then don't keep me waiting.
text.zh-CN: 那就别让我等太久。
